verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents an in-product agent: users type an @agent directive in chat to start an agentic session that uses tools and skills, so natural-language commands can drive actions such as web search. There is no evidence that the product itself (workspaces, settings, documents, admin) can be operated through natural language rather than the GUI or API. Missing for 10: natural-language control of the product's own configuration and management, any hands-on or independent corroboration of the agent executing commands reliably, and a single agent surface per chat with no broader NL command layer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
